entries.title: Proverbs 29:1
segments: He that being often reproved hardeneth his neck Shall suddenly be destroyed, and that without remedy.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:2
segments: When the righteous are increased, the people rejoice; But when a wicked man beareth rule, the people sigh.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:3
segments: Whoso loveth wisdom rejoiceth his father; But he that keepeth company with harlots wasteth [his] substance.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:4
segments: The king by justice establisheth the land; But he that exacteth gifts overthroweth it.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:5
segments: A man that flattereth his neighbor Spreadeth a net for his steps.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:6
segments: In the transgression of an evil man there is a snare; But the righteous doth sing and rejoice.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:7
segments: The righteous taketh knowledge of the cause of the poor; The wicked hath not understanding to know [it].

entries.title: Proverbs 29:8
segments: Scoffers set a city in a flame; But wise men turn away wrath.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:9
segments: If a wise man hath a controversy with a foolish man, Whether he be angry or laugh, there will be no rest.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:10
segments: The bloodthirsty hate him that is perfect; And as for the upright, they seek his life.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:11
segments: A fool uttereth all his anger; But a wise man keepeth it back and stilleth it.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:12
segments: If a ruler hearkeneth to falsehood, All his servants are wicked.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:13
segments: The poor man and the oppressor meet together; Jehovah lighteneth the eyes of them both.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:14
segments: The king that faithfully judgeth the poor, His throne shall be established for ever.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:15
segments: The rod and reproof give wisdom; But a child left to himself causeth shame to his mother.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:16
segments: When the wicked are increased, transgression increaseth; But the righteous shall look upon their fall.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:17
segments: Correct thy son, and he will give thee rest; Yea, he will give delight unto thy soul.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:18
segments: Where there is no vision, the people cast off restraint; But he that keepeth the law, happy is he.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:19
segments: A servant will not be corrected by words; For though he understand, he will not give heed.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:20
segments: Seest thou a man that is hasty in his words? There is more hope of a fool than of him.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:21
segments: He that delicately bringeth up his servant from a child Shall have him become a son at the last.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:22
segments: An angry man stirreth up strife, And a wrathful man aboundeth in transgression.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:23
segments: A man's pride shall bring him low; But he that is of a lowly spirit shall obtain honor.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:24
segments: Whoso is partner with a thief hateth his own soul; He heareth the adjuration and uttereth nothing.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:25
segments: The fear of man bringeth a snare; But whoso putteth his trust in Jehovah shall be safe.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:26
segments: Many seek the ruler's favor; But a man's judgment [cometh] from Jehovah.

entries.title: Proverbs 29:27
segments: An unjust man is an abomination to the righteous; And he that is upright in the way is an abomination to the wicked.
